scope: Isolated indigo icon asset review; no runtime, device or release claim

passes.finding: Previous palette was explicitly rejected; the strong broad rising-path silhouette remains useful at small sizes.
passes.action: Edited artwork with built-in imagegen to midnight, ivory and periwinkle; retained the silhouette and safe margins.
passes.result: RGB opaque source inspected; zero measured green/teal pixels; slight low-contrast bitmap variation disclosed.

passes.finding: The ordinary unpadded icon should not be marked as a maskable source because the full mark exceeds the stricter maskable safe circle.
passes.action: Prepared dedicated opaque PWA and Android padding variants with no creative source edits.
passes.result: PWA max foreground radius 0.383572 < 0.4; Android max radius 0.298068 < 33/108; point and tail remain visible in QA simulations.

passes.finding: Active selectors currently refer to old artwork; asset creation alone does not update a running app or installed web app.
passes.action: Supplied matching Apple filenames, Android mipmap resources, web metadata guidance, exact provenance and verification manifest. Root owns integration.
passes.result: 23 integration images are opaque; all PNGs RGB; ICO frames opaque; both XML files parse; Apple catalog names match.

visual_observations.small_sizes: Upward point and broad curved path remain distinct at 24 pixels; the overall directional silhouette remains recognizable at 16 pixels.
visual_observations.mask_simulations: Rounded-square, circle, PWA maskable and Android adaptive simulations retain the full significant mark.
visual_observations.surfaces: Midnight canvas separates from a light surface; ivory and periwinkle remain clear on a dark surface.
visual_observations.style: One bold two-plane mark without text, fine detail, stock briefcase or checkmark clutter.

parent_independent_review: Root independently inspected and accepted the large preview, actual small sizes and mask contact sheet before copying integration assets; recorded in the coordination message on 2026-11-17. No native launcher/device claim.
